definitions.explanation: A person who creates paintings as a profession or vocation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}な→有名：01106_yuumei⟧{画家|がか}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{画家|がか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}している→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm aiming to become a painter.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{画家|がか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{子|こ}ども→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{画家|がか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたかった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦そうだ→そうだ：10076_souda⟧。
examples.english: I heard that my older sister wanted to become a painter since she was a child.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{画家|がか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧や⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{描|か}いて→描く：02013_egaku⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That painter has created many paintings of flowers and mountains and is known around the world.

notes:
{画家|がか} specifically refers to painters who create visual art.

WORD COMPOSITION:
- {画|が} (picture, painting) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (professional, -ist)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {画家|がか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a painter)
- {画家|がか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ (to aim to be a painter)
- 〜⟦{派|は}→派：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{画家|がか} (painter of the ~ school)

TYPES:
- ⟦{油絵|あぶらえ}→油絵：07076_aburae⟧{画家|がか} (oil painter)
- ⟦{水彩|すいさい}→水彩：24163_suisai⟧{画家|がか} (watercolor painter)
- ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧{画家|がか} (landscape painter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧: artist (broader, loanword)
- ⟦{芸術家|げいじゅつか}→芸術家：14979_geijutsuka⟧: artist (broader)
- ⟦{絵描|えか}き→絵描き：28010_ekaki⟧: painter (informal)
